description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the DataGroupDao class, focusing on testing API permission retrieval for specific API endpoints and user roles within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetApiPermissionsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the getApiPermissions method of DataGroupDao class in different scenarios, such as permissions for 'Ess' role and combined roles.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and creates an instance of DataGroupDao before each test.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEss
methods.description: Tests that the API permissions for 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Api\JobTitleAPI' with 'ESS' role are correctly retrieved and validated.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEssAndAdmin
methods.description: Tests combined API permissions for 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Api\JobTitleAPI' with roles 'ESS' and 'Admin' are correctly retrieved and validated.
